rationale: Dispatching D1 to verify three buildings in the Financial District where trapped survivors were spotted by AIR 1 (B4902, B4721, B4960) to guide immediate rescue deployment. Dispatching D2 to survey high-occupancy unscanned SoMa targets (A-11 and B5528, ~8,450 total occupants) with high predicted collapse and major damage risks that AIR 1 has not yet reached. D3 is held in reserve for follow-up verification and emerging fire or collapse calls.

missions.purpose: Confirm collapse severity and locate trapped survivors reported at 447 Battery, California Bank, and 235 Pine.
Survey unscanned high-risk PG&E block and Rincon Annex (~8,450 occupants) for structural collapse and casualties.
